Filtered transcript count data

Source: R/filtered_txi.R
filtered_txi.Rd

This dataset contains transcript-level count data obtained with Salmon, imported using tximport, and annotated with Ensembl gene identifiers. Duplicate entries in gene biotypes were previously removed to ensure consistency in downstream analyses.

Usage

filtered_txi

Format

A list object with the following elements:

counts

Matrix of transcript counts.

abundance

Matrix of normalized transcript abundances.

length

Effective transcript lengths.

metadata

Data frame containing sample-level metadata.

Source

Processed internally from transcript quantifications generated with Salmon.

Details

This object is typically used for differential gene expression analysis with DESeq2, after importing transcript quantifications and mapping them to Ensembl identifiers.

Examples

data(filtered_txi)
names(filtered_txi)
#> [1] "abundance"           "counts"              "length"             
#> [4] "countsFromAbundance"
